dedupe_keys.name: hospital accessibility in spain 2010 2024 travel time and distance to the nearest hospital by census tract

description: This data set gives, for every census tract in Spain and every year from 2010 to 2024, the travel time and distance to the nearest hospital on foot and by car. The producer is Virgilio Pérez at the University of Valencia, who located hospitals from OpenStreetMap and computed routes with the open-source OSRM routing engine, choosing the nearest hospital by driving time. Coverage is all census tracts of Spain, the country's smallest statistical areas, over fifteen years. Each yearly CSV file has the tract code (CUSEC) and walking time, walking distance, driving time and driving distance, so it joins directly to census population data; reproducible code is included. The files are available as a free download from Zenodo under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: OpenStreetMap hospital tags do not separate emergency departments from other hospitals and may be incomplete in earlier years, the road network appears to be a single recent snapshot, and travel times ignore congestion. Simulation uses: measuring how many people lose timely hospital access when a hospital or road closes in a flood or other disruption, planning emergency and hospital capacity, and studying rural access over time. Related records: the Malaria Atlas travel time maps (data-map-travel-time-to-healthcare) give global accessibility grids, and the flood traffic hospital access model for Germany (model-flood-traffic-hospital-access-germany) models hazard impacts on access.
name: Hospital Accessibility in Spain (2010-2024): travel time and distance to the nearest hospital by census tract
schema_summary: One CSV per year (dt_2010 to dt_2024): CUSEC census tract identifier, time_walk, dist_walk, time_car, dist_car to the nearest hospital; reproducible code

sources.note: Creator Pérez (University of Valencia); CC BY 4.0; published 2025-09-26; 16 files incl. yearly dt_YYYY.csv of about 2.3 MB; variables CUSEC, time_walk, dist_walk, time_car, dist_car; hospitals from OpenStreetMap; routes computed with the OSRM engine; nearest hospital by shortest driving time

title_en: Hospital Accessibility in Spain (2010-2024): travel time and distance to the nearest hospital by census tract
